title: Testing for Essential Heterogeneity in the Marginal Treatment Effects Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.34198v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a test for essential heterogeneity in the marginal treatment effects model without imposing additive separability. On the observed support of the propensity score, no essential heterogeneity implies that the conditional mean of the outcome is affine in the propensity score, and this affine restriction is the sharp testable implication of the null. We implement the test using a projected Gaussian-process statistic that is Neyman-orthogonal to the first-step estimation error, so the multiplier bootstrap avoids re-estimating nuisance parameters. Monte Carlo experiments show accurate size control and good power, and, unlike the fixed-scale integrated conditional moment benchmark, the data-driven median rule retains power as the conditioning set grows in dimension. In an application to the Ugandan ELA programme, the omnibus statistic rejects the null of no essential heterogeneity for aspirations at the midline follow-up.

translated_title: 检验边际处理效应模型中的本质异质性
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种检验边际处理效应模型中本质异质性的方法，且无需施加可加可分性假设。在倾向得分的观测支撑集上，不存在本质异质性意味着结果变量的条件均值是倾向得分的仿射函数，而这一仿射约束正是原假设的尖锐可检验含义。我们采用一个投影高斯过程统计量来实施该检验，该统计量对第一步估计误差具有Neyman正交性，因此乘子自举法无需重新估计讨厌参数。蒙特卡洛实验表明该检验具有准确的水平控制和良好的功效；与固定尺度的积分条件矩基准检验不同，数据驱动的中位数规则在条件集维度增大时仍能保持功效。在乌干达ELA项目的实证应用中，综合统计量在中期随访阶段拒绝了“抱负方面不存在本质异质性”的原假设。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需可加可分性假设的边际处理效应模型本质异质性检验方法，借助Neyman正交的投影高斯过程统计量与乘子自举实现稳健推断，并在乌干达ELA项目中识别出抱负方面的本质异质性证据。
